description: This file contains implementation of OCI-specific request signing, request building, and response handling logic for integration with OCI's generative AI API. It includes classes for request signing, request wrapping, configuration, and streaming response parsing, as well as utilities for credential management and message adaptation between different schemas.

classes.name: OCIRequestWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for OCI-compatible HTTP request data, providing properties such as method, url, headers, body, and path_url.

classes.name: OCIChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class specifically for OCI's API, including methods for signing requests, environment validation, and request transformation.

classes.name: OCIStreamWrapper
classes.description: Custom stream wrapper for processing OCI streaming responses, with methods to parse and yield chunks of responses.

methods.name: str sha256_base64(data: bytes)
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of input bytes and encodes it in base64.

methods.name: build_signature_string(method, path, headers, signed_headers)
methods.description: Constructs the string to be signed for OCI request signing, based on HTTP method, path, headers, and signed headers.

methods.name: load_private_key_from_str(key_str: str)
methods.description: Loads an RSA private key from a PEM string.

methods.name: load_private_key_from_file(file_path: str)
methods.description: Loads an RSA private key from a file path.

methods.name: OCIVendors get_vendor_from_model(model: str)
methods.description: Extracts OCI vendor information based on the model name.

methods.name: List[CohereMessage] adapt_messages_to_cohere_standard(self, messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Transforms a list of messages into Cohere-specific message format for chat requests.

methods.name: List[CohereTool] adapt_tool_definitions_to_cohere_standard(self, tools: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Converts generic tool definitions into Cohere-specific format.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input messages and parameters into OCI-specific request payload.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes OCI responses, handling vendor-specific formats and errors.

methods.name: "OCIStreamWrapper" get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, AsyncHTTPHandler]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
